entries.title: Roboquest

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route, with the same core Roboquest content as Xbox and later PlayStation ports. No platform-exclusive campaign or mode content is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Roboquest on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or the Xbox PC/Microsoft Store route for Windows PC; Xbox Game Pass is also a valid access route when available.

all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture/input route and current PC storefront support.
skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Optimized Xbox Series X/S console release.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture platform.
skip: later console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 console release, including physical release route.
all_releases.reason: skip: later console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented; PC is both complete and the best fidelity/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: PlayStation and Xbox versions are platform ports/access routes, not remasters or separate definitive editions. Developer post-release support has ended, so archive the current final content state.
